result.title: The Wealth of Agents: Scaling Agentic AI Across Developers
result.summary: Today's agentic systems are typically designed, built, and deployed by single developers with full control over all participating agents. While this simplifies development, it limits the potential scale of agentic systems. We study multi-developer agentic systems (MDAs) which enable developers to collaboratively build agentic systems to push frontier capability beyond what any individual developer could achieve alone. We construct empirical and theoretical models of developers to compare MDAs with single-developer agentic systems (SDAs). On GAIA, a general assistant benchmark, a population of specialized developers whose individual agents do not exceed 35% accuracy reaches 70% when their agents are combined in an MDA. This MDA performs 12 percentage points above the median general-purpose SDA built with several times each specialist's development budget. Our theoretical models show how MDAs can incentivize specialization and encourage more efficient use of aggregated developer resources. Put together, our results make a preliminary case for MDAs as a new scaling axis by enabling developers with diverse capabilities and resources to advance agentic AI collaboratively.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究「多开发者智能体系统」（MDA），即由不同开发者分别构建的专业化智能体协作组成的系统，通过经验与理论建模比较 MDA 与单开发者系统，并在 GAIA 基准上验证协作系统在准确率与资源效率上的优势。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究焦点是开发者协作的组织与资源分配经济学，智能体之间是外部消息协作而非内部 latent 状态生成与更新，也未涉及视觉证据筛选、推理状态、停止决策或监督机制，与 LVR 主线缺少可核查的具体联系。
